entry.title: Running Talos Linux with GPU Passthrough on QEMU
entry.summary: I’ve been spending a lot of time with Talos Linux Talos is lightweight, QEMU is great for homelabs, but GPU passthrough is where things get a bit hacky. So I decided to make it work — and I put the results in a repo: https://github.com/kubebn/talos-qemu-gpu-passthrough Running Talos on QEMU is easy enough. Spin up a VM, boot the ISO, apply a machine config — done. But once I needed NVIDIA GPU support for workloads (think AI/ML testing or just experimenting with device plugins). Here's the thing about GPU passthrough - you can't just point QEMU at your GPU and hope for the best. The host OS needs to completely release control of the GPU to the VFIO subsystem. This means: Your GPU disappears from the host (no more nvidia-smi on that card) It's like lending your car to a friend - they get all the control, you get none. OVMF and UEFI Considerations Modern GPUs are picky about firmware. The scripts detect if your system supports OVMF (UEFI for VMs) and configure things appropriately. This is especially important for newer cards that expect UEFI environments. Closing thoughts This is homelab territory, so expect some rough edges. If you’ve ever wrestled with PCI passthrough, you know it’s always a bit finicky. But hey, I got it working, and now my Talos VMs can see GPUs just fine. Hopefully it helps someone else avoid a weekend of trial-and-error.

entry.title: 3 Myths About AI That Are Holding People Back
entry.summary:
Whenever I talk to professionals, entrepreneurs, or students about AI, I notice a pattern.
Let’s bust the 3 biggest ones I hear almost every week. ❌ Myth 1: “AI Will Replace My Job” The truth? AI replaces tasks, not entire jobs. AI can draft emails → but you add context & strategy AI can write code → but you design the architecture AI can summarise data → but you make the decision Jobs don’t disappear. They evolve. 💡 Example: At ReThynk AI, we use AI to cut repetitive work, freeing humans to focus on innovation. ❌ Myth 2: “You Need to Be Technical to Use AI” Wrong. Teachers → design lesson plans in minutes Solopreneurs → create marketing campaigns with no budget Consultants → analyze client reports in half the time All you need is the ability to write clear prompts. That’s why I call prompt engineering the new literacy. 💡 Resource: My book series ChatGPT Prompts breaks this down into a simple framework anyone can apply. ❌ Myth 3: “AI is Just a Fancy Tool” AI isn’t just a tool. It’s a system enabler. When you combine AI with repeatable workflows, it becomes: A business partner A scaling engine A creativity amplifier That’s how I’ve published 40+ books, launched the ReThynk AI Magazine, and built real-world solutions like UrbanGuard AI. 💡 Lesson: If you treat AI as just another app, you’ll miss the revolution. Final Thought AI won’t replace you. But someone who knows how to use AI effectively will. The myths aren’t just wrong — they’re holding people back from growth.
